name: Rasht
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: No first-party public page identifying a Rasht land-registration office or parcel-map service was located. The official municipal and national SDI entry points could not be reviewed through available fetch tools. A secondary report attributes road-network data publishing to the Rasht municipal ICT organization, but this is not primary evidence of a land registry or parcel layer.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Rasht municipal SDI includes a current cadastre layer, whether the provincial land-registration offices publish a city-specific public workflow, and whether any public full polygon is available.
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. No citywide completeness is asserted. No owner/address/account/token values retained. At most three complete native parcel geometries may be retained for this city; none was obtained.
technicalBlocker: The municipal and national SDI shells were not accessible through the available web fetch path, and no official local registry catalogue or anonymous parcel endpoint was found.
